summary: Join our Data Visualization Techniques Training Course to master the art of presenting data clearly and effectively. Elevate your analytical skills today!
lede: Data visualization training helps professionals who create or review visual reports turn business data into decision-focused charts and dashboards. Learners practice defining an analytical question, preparing datasets, choosing visuals for comparisons and trends, and building and checking dashboards for accuracy and accessibility, then explaining what the findings mean for a business decision.
audienceIntro: This course suits professionals who create, review, or rely on charts, dashboards, and visual reports. It is appropriate for foundation to intermediate learners who need practical data visualization training without becoming software developers or statistical specialists.
modules: Dashboard Construction in a BI Tool
Excel and BI Tool Visual Workflows
prerequisites: No programming experience is required. You should have basic workplace experience with tables, percentages, and business reports, plus access to a laptop for practical exercises. Familiarity with Microsoft Excel is useful but not essential. The course teaches AI-assisted visualization and dashboard configuration at an operational application level, not technical engineering or software development level.
